transfer_from_invoked.meaning: a transferFrom call is executed on TokenWrapper using an allowance

from_is_holder.meaning: the from parameter of transferFrom is the actual token holder whose balance is debited

event_from_address.meaning: the from address recorded in the emitted Transfer event

holder_address.meaning: the actual token holder address passed as the from parameter whose balance decreases

assumptions: Internal _balanceOf accounting is updated correctly and actual token balances reflect the proper transfer.
The Transfer event is emitted during transferFrom.
The from parameter passed to transferFrom is the token holder whose balance is debited.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the spender is authorized or unauthorized; allowance use is described generically, so the condition is not narrowed by authorization.

limitations: Formalizes only the event-from mismatch impact; downstream off-chain harms are not covered by this claim.
Symbolic addresses are used; no concrete transaction, addresses, or amounts are supplied.
The correspondence is asserted at the report level; runtime binding to the emitted event field is deferred.
